task: Native pipe runtime tools resource check.

resource_risks.description: Parent process can keep pipe file descriptors open after spawning producer or consumer, causing downstream stdin EOF to never arrive.
resource_risks.mitigation: Command builders are dropped immediately after spawn so parent-held pipe descriptors are released.
evidence: Focused Rust test initially timed out until Command builder drop was added, then passed.

resource_risks.description: Producer or consumer can hang and remain running after the Tauri command returns.
resource_risks.mitigation: wait_native_pipe_children tracks both children and timeout kills/waits both process groups through kill_and_wait_child.

resource_risks.description: Pipe or stderr buffers can fill if the parent waits without reading process output.
resource_risks.mitigation: Producer stderr, consumer stdout, and consumer stderr are read on separate threads while child wait runs.

lifecycle_checks.create_path: run_native_pipe_probe_processes spawns producer and consumer with std::process::Command
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: wait_native_pipe_children waits for both children or kills/waits both on timeout

lifecycle_checks.create_path: thread::spawn read_limited for producer stderr, consumer stdout, consumer stderr
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: join all reader handles before returning NativePipeProbeReport

measurement_checks.tool: cargo test focused Rust unit test
measurement_checks.threshold: printf | wc -c completes within 2500ms and returns status passed

notes: Full package pipeline validation is recorded separately in the task validation and evaluation files.
